topic: Preview RAG client-IP header used by in-memory rate limiter
source_finding: Vercel documents x-forwarded-for as the public IP of the client and says it overwrites the header to prevent IP spoofing. It documents x-vercel-forwarded-for as equivalent; x-forwarded-for may be overwritten by a proxy in front of Vercel.

code_mapping.behavior: previewRateAllowed reads the first comma-separated value of x-forwarded-for

assessment: No code change justified for the current direct *.vercel.app Preview path from the official header contract. Re-review if traffic is routed through another proxy.
limitations: Documentation review only; no live header probe was performed.
The in-memory limiter is per function instance and is not a durable/global abuse control or spend cap.
This does not clear the Vercel WAF rate-limit release gate.
